budget.noBudget: No budget set for this period.

settings.title: Settings
settings.preferencesLead: How amounts and dates are shown, and how the app looks.
settings.budgetLead: Your income sources, and the ceiling for the spend bar.
settings.remindersLead: Whether and when to nudge you before a charge.
settings.listsLead: Categories and payment methods across the app.
settings.securityLead: Ways to sign in, and keeping the account safe.
settings.currencyHelp: Everything converts into this currency using daily ECB rates.
settings.languageHelp: Applies to the app's text and to how amounts and dates are shown.
settings.budgetHelp: With income sources below, expected income drives the period — and this ceiling clamps it down.
settings.anchorBody: Anchor the budget period to your pay day. Set 25 and the period runs the 25th to the 24th — so a salary landing on 25 September covers 25 Sep – 24 Oct. Anchors also clamp like the recurrence engine: day 31 becomes the 28th of February.
settings.remindHelp: 0 reminds on the due date. Per-subscription overrides win over this default — while reminders are on. Switching them off silences every override too.
settings.errCurrency: Use a 3-letter currency code, like DKK or EUR.
settings.errBudget: The budget needs to be a positive number (or empty).
settings.errAnchor: Pay day anchors run from 1 to 31 — or leave it empty.
settings.errRemind: Reminders run from 0 to 60 days before a charge.

incomeSources.title: Income sources
incomeSources.description: Salaries and side gigs, each on their own schedule. Every arrival shows up in the calendar and counts towards the period's budget.
incomeSources.empty: Nothing here yet — add the first job below.
incomeSources.name: Name
incomeSources.errName: Give the income source a name.
incomeSources.errCurrency: Use a 3-letter currency code, like DKK or EUR.
incomeSources.errAmount: The amount needs to be a positive number.
incomeSources.errStart: Pick the date the income started.
incomeSources.errStartAfterNext: The start date needs to be on or before the next arrival.

managedLists.title: Categories & payment methods
managedLists.description: The starter lists, yours to shape. The order here is the order the subscription form offers.
managedLists.empty: Nothing here yet — add the first one below.
managedLists.inUse: Still used by {count, plural, one {# subscription} other {# subscriptions}} — move them to another row first.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.description: Sign in with Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key — nothing to type, nothing to phish.
passkey.name: Name
passkey.nameHelp: Only a label — the key itself never leaves your device.
passkey.empty: No passkeys yet — add one to sign in without a password.
passkey.insecure: Passkeys need a secure context — HTTPS, or http on localhost. This page is being served over plain http on a network name, so browsers will refuse to create passkeys here.
passkey.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn.
passkey.cancelled: The browser cancelled the passkey prompt.
passkey.alreadyRegistered: This device already holds a passkey for this account.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enabled: Enabled — sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.disabled: Add a second step to sign-in with an authenticator app.
twoFactor.helpEnable: Checked before a secret is generated.
twoFactor.helpDisable: Turning two-factor off also forgets trusted devices.
twoFactor.helpRegenerate: Regenerating invalidates every previous backup code.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app, or type this secret in by hand:
twoFactor.saveHelp: Each works once if you lose the authenticator. They are shown again on the next step and can be regenerated, but never emailed.
twoFactor.keepSafe: Keep these somewhere safe — each signs in once if the authenticator is unavailable.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.caution: The feed URL and every API key are bearer credentials — anyone who has one can read everything in your account.
integrations.feedDescription: Subscribe in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or anything that speaks iCal. Twelve months of payments, with alarms from your reminder settings.
integrations.rotateNote: Rotating invalidates the old URL immediately — every subscribed calendar needs the new one.
integrations.feedOff: The feed is off. Enable it to get a URL calendars can subscribe to.
integrations.keysDescription: Full access for scripts and dashboards: send x-api-key instead of a session cookie. Limited to 600 requests per hour per key.
integrations.shownOnce: This key is shown once — store it somewhere safe.
integrations.emptyKeys: No keys yet — create one when a script needs access.
integrations.rotateDescription: The current URL stops working immediately. Every subscribed calendar needs the new one before it syncs again.
integrations.disableDescription: Subscribed calendars stop updating immediately. If you enable it again, the URL will be new.
integrations.createDescription: Name it after where it runs — “Home dashboard”, “n8n”, “Raycast”.
integrations.revokeDescription: Requests using “{name}” start failing immediately. This cannot be undone.

channels.title: Delivery channels
channels.description: Every reminder fans out to each enabled channel.
channels.empty: No channels yet — add one and Subdue will start reaching you outside the inbox.
channels.testDelivered: Test delivered — go check it arrived.
channels.deleteDescription: Reminders stop being delivered to “{name}”. This cannot be undone.
channels.deliveriesDescription: The last 20 sends, with retries and their last error.
channels.deliveriesEmpty: Nothing sent yet — deliveries appear here once a reminder fires.
channels.name: Name
channels.errConfig: Some of those settings did not validate — check the host, port and addresses.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.caughtUpBody: Reminders about upcoming charges land here.
inbox.summary: {unread} unread of {count, plural, one {# reminder} other {# reminders}}
inbox.whenOverdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

sharing.splitCaption: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · you absorb the remainder
sharing.yourBudgetCaption: Full charge, as it leaves your account · {covered} covered
sharing.coveredByOthersCaption: {count, plural, one {From # person · each sees only their own share} other {From # people · each sees only their own share}}
sharing.coveredByOthersEmpty: Add people and their shares show up here
sharing.linkExpires: One-time link · expires in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
sharing.linkExpired: Link expired — create a new one
sharing.linkNone: Name only — no link, no access
sharing.removeBody: They lose access right away and their reminders for this subscription are deleted. Their share returns to you — the subscription itself is untouched.
sharing.errOverAllocated: That pushes the shares over the price. Bring another share down first.
sharing.errSharesExceedPrice: This price is below the shares you have already agreed. Rebalance the split first.
sharing.sectionSharedDescription: Someone else pays the bill; your budget counts only your share.
sharing.memberNote: The full charge stays on {owner} — your budget only counts your share.
sharing.memberReadOnly: Read-only — the owner manages the subscription.
sharing.leaveBody: This subscription disappears from your budget and its reminder stops. {owner} keeps paying the bill.
sharing.inviteBulletSee: See the subscription and its renewal date
sharing.inviteBulletReminder: A reminder on the day, at your share
sharing.inviteBulletPrivacy: No bank details, no notes, no other people
sharing.inviteNote: One-time link. Accepting does not change who pays the bill.
sharing.inviteNewHere: New to Subdue? Creating an account takes a minute:
sharing.inviteInvalidBody: Invite links work once and last seven days. Ask the person who sent it for a fresh one.
sharing.inviteAlreadyTitle: You are already in this split
sharing.inviteAlreadyBody: You will find it under “Shared with you” on your subscriptions page.
sharing.inviteAcceptedBody: {owner} keeps paying the full charge. Your budget counts only your share, and the reminder is on.
sharing.inviteDeclinedBody: {owner} still sees your name in the split. Nothing was added to your account.

dashboard.upcomingDescription: Rolled forward from their cycles · through {date}.
dashboard.byCategoryHint: Tap a category to include or exclude it from the total. Use the arrow to see its subscriptions.
dashboard.categoryChartLabel: Spending by category for this period

subscriptionForm.name: Name
subscriptionForm.notifyBefore: Notify me before it is due

subscriptionForm.nonePaymentMethods: None yet — add payment methods in Settings.
subscriptionForm.notesPlaceholder: Anything worth remembering at renewal time
subscriptionForm.logoHint: Upload a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP (up to 1 MiB), or paste an image URL — external ones load straight from that host.
subscriptionForm.remindHint: Leave empty to use the default; 0 reminds on the due date.
subscriptionForm.endsHint: After this date the subscription stops counting toward totals, the calendar, the budget and reminders.

subscriptionForm.errNext: A next payment date is required.
subscriptionForm.errCycle: The cycle needs a whole number of at least 1.
subscriptionForm.errLogoType: Logo must be a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
subscriptionForm.errPaymentMethod: That payment method no longer exists — pick another.
subscriptionForm.errLogoMissing: The logo upload did not finish — try again.
